about: A release is what the fold renders over the release it replaces. What the build made stands as made, by digest. The lock and the receipts are the published ones, the lock carried as it was signed when its lines are the lines the fold publishes. Each leaf a view writes is rendered from the published fold, and every other leaf is the laid copy's. A foreign leaf is never released.

The release is laid whole in a clone of its own and named by releaseDigest. The clone is removed after unless REBIRTH_KEEP keeps it and names where. Each leaf unlike the laid copy, or held by one side only, is named.
